mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fact that, some of the adhoc commissions in the past recommended the establishment of such a body."

Training is a continuous activity from recruitment (induction and orientation to retirement …..

Personnel procurement means the acquisition of the individual men and women, which an organisation requires for its tasks.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the authorised absence of an officer from duty for a specific purpose as provided for in the Public Service Rules."
Leave refers to the authorised absence of an officer from duty for a specific purpose as provided for in the Public Service Rules.

The Chairman is the Director of Personnel Management Department while other members should be senior officers of not less than GL. 08 at the state, area or zonal offices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a special leave granted an officer for the purpose of taking an examination."

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process which enables an organisation to meet its current and projected manpower requirements."
Career development is a process which enables an organisation to meet its current and projected manpower requirements.

PenCom is the regulatory body set up to monitor the activities of PFCs to ensure that investments made with the funds are in line with the laid- down prescriptions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an inevitable phase of a public servant."
Retirement is an inevitable phase of a public servant.
